name: Quixotic ExchangeV4 missing buyer authorization
summary: ExchangeV4.fillSellOrder validates only the seller signature, then pulls ERC-20 payment from the caller-supplied buyer without buyer authorization. The attacker signed sales of a fake ERC-1155 token and named allowance-holding wallets as buyers, draining OP and WETH.

campaign.selection: successful ExchangeV4 fillSellOrder (0x912d97fc) txs whose buyer argument differs from the sender; all are from attacker 0x0a080508

notes: The anchor paid in WETH, which the exchange accepts only after its payment registry approved it; that approval, 107 blocks after deployment, is the latest change the anchor needed.
Loss is every buyer debit in the 891 calls, marketplace fee included, priced by DefiLlama per ~1,500-block window (WETH at the ETH quote).
